commercials.titleMm: ဒုတိယအကြိမ် စားသုံးမှု
commercials.objective: Invite existing client-approved customers to give structured feedback and choose a future client-approved update.
commercials.tension: A first trial does not automatically teach a brand why a customer did or did not return.
commercials.territory: The second serving begins with listening.
commercials.hook: A used, clean product pack sits beside a written note: “What would make this easier?”
commercials.world: Kitchen counter, desk, travel bag and feedback station; product details proposed/TBC.
commercials.sensory: Pack opening, lid click, pencil mark, phone vibration and a short voice note tone.
commercials.friction: A customer remembers a small problem but has nowhere simple to express it.
commercials.reveal: A guided three-question card turns friction into a practical priority.
commercials.craft: Close frames study how the pack is held, opened and stored without judging performance.
commercials.human: The customer chooses what to share and whether to receive a reply.
commercials.choice: One tap selects an approved update, trial or no-follow-up option.
commercials.payoff: The note becomes a clear next action, not a promise.
commercials.scale: Different hands identify different needs, making the feedback diverse rather than statistically representative.
commercials.responsible: Do not claim packaging, sustainability, compliance, storage, price or product changes without separately approved evidence.
commercials.cta: Tell us what the next serving should solve—choose your approved response path.
